slug: 2026-01-27 SA's Telcos, Banks At War With Govt Over 6,500% ID Verification Fee Hike

facts.fact: The article describes the National Population Register as the register against which private companies verify customer identity.
Banks, mobile operators and insurers verify customers' identities in real time against the National Population Register through the Online Verification System, at ZAR 10 a check since 1 July 2025.
Home Affairs says fee revenue is earmarked for an upgrade to what it calls an Intelligent Population Register, the foundation for a future digital ID.
